sentences.en: A poor shoemaker had only one piece of leather.
sentences.tgt: Un:o pauvre:a cordonnier:n possédait:v seulement:a un:o morceau:n de:o cuir:n .:o

sentences.en: He lived with his wife in a small shop.
sentences.tgt: Il:o vivait:v avec:o sa:o femme:n dans:o une:o petite:a boutique:n .:o

sentences.en: That evening, he cut the leather into shapes for shoes.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o soir-là:o ,:o il:o découpa:v le:o cuir:n en:o formes:n pour:o des:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: He left the pieces on the table.
sentences.tgt: Il:o laissa:v les:o morceaux:n sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: The shoemaker went to bed.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cordonnier:n alla:v se:o coucher:v .:o

sentences.en: In the morning, he came back to the shop.
sentences.tgt: Le:o matin:n ,:o il:o revint:v à:o la:o boutique:n .:o

sentences.en: Two perfect shoes stood on the table.
sentences.tgt: Deux:o chaussures:n parfaites:a étaient:v posées:a sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon a rich man came into the shop.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a un:o homme:n riche:a entra:v dans:o la:o boutique:n .:o

sentences.en: He tried on the shoes and loved them.
sentences.tgt: Il:o essaya:v les:o chaussures:n et:o les:o adora:v .:o

sentences.en: He paid the shoemaker a lot of gold for them.
sentences.tgt: Il:o paya:v beaucoup:a d':o or:n au:o cordonnier:n pour:o elles:o .:o

sentences.en: The shoemaker bought leather for two pairs of shoes.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cordonnier:n acheta:v du:o cuir:n pour:o deux:o paires:n de:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: That night, he cut the leather into shapes again.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit-là:o ,:o il:o découpa:v de:o nouveau:a le:o cuir:n en:o formes:n .:o

sentences.en: He left the pieces on the table.
sentences.tgt: Il:o laissa:v les:o morceaux:n sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: In the morning, two pairs of shoes stood there.
sentences.tgt: Le:o matin:n ,:o deux:o paires:n de:o chaussures:n se:o trouvaient:v là:a .:o

sentences.en: Two more customers came and bought them.
sentences.tgt: Deux:o autres:a clients:n vinrent:v et:o les:o achetèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: Soon the shoemaker had gold for leather for four pairs.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a le:o cordonnier:n eut:v de:o l':o or:n pour:o du:o cuir:n pour:o quatre:o paires:n .:o

sentences.en: Every night, he cut leather for more shoes.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o nuit:n ,:o il:o découpait:v du:o cuir:n pour:o plus:a de:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: Every morning, shoes stood on the table.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o matin:n ,:o des:o chaussures:n se:o trouvaient:v sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: People came from other towns to buy his shoes.
sentences.tgt: Des:o gens:n venaient:v d':o autres:a villes:n pour:o acheter:v ses:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: The shoemaker and his wife became rich from the shoes.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cordonnier:n et:o sa:o femme:n devinrent:v riches:a grâce:o aux:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: But the shoemaker never saw who made the shoes.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o cordonnier:n ne:o vit:v jamais:o qui:o fabriquait:v les:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: He wanted to know who helped him every night.
sentences.tgt: Il:o voulait:v savoir:v qui:o l':o aidait:v chaque:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: "Let us hide and know who helps us," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Cachons:v -nous:o et:o sachons:v qui:o nous:o aide:v ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: That night, he cut leather again.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit:n -là:a ,:o il:o découpa:v du:o cuir:n de:o nouveau:a .:o

sentences.en: He left the pieces on the table.
sentences.tgt: Il:o laissa:v les:o morceaux:n sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: Then the shoemaker and his wife hid.
sentences.tgt: Alors:o le:o cordonnier:n et:o sa:o femme:n se:o cachèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: They waited quietly for midnight.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o attendirent:v tranquillement:a jusqu'à:o minuit:n .:o

sentences.en: At midnight, two little elves ran into the shop.
sentences.tgt: À:o minuit:n ,:o deux:o petits:a elfes:n coururent:v dans:o la:o boutique:n .:o

sentences.en: The elves had no clothes on.
sentences.tgt: Les:o elfes:n n':o avaient:v pas:o de:o vêtements:n sur:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: They climbed on the table.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o grimpèrent:v sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: The elves cut and sewed the leather into shoes.
sentences.tgt: Les:o elfes:n coupèrent:v et:o cousirent:v le:o cuir:n en:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: Before the sun came up, the elves ran out.
sentences.tgt: Avant:o que:o le:o soleil:n se:o lève:v ,:o les:o elfes:n coururent:v dehors:a .:o

sentences.en: "We must thank the two little elves," said the wife.
sentences.tgt: «:o Nous:o devons:v remercier:v les:o deux:o petits:a elfes:n »:o ,:o dit:v la:o femme:n .:o

sentences.en: "They have no clothes, even in the cold," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ils:o n':o ont:v pas:o de:o vêtements:n ,:o même:o dans:o le:o froid:n »:o ,:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: She took cloth and sewed tiny shirts and coats.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o prit:v du:o tissu:n et:o cousit:v de:o petites:a chemises:n et:o des:o manteaux:n .:o

sentences.en: The shoemaker cut leather for two shoes to match.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cordonnier:n coupa:v du:o cuir:n pour:o deux:o chaussures:n assorties:a .:o

sentences.en: That night, they put the clothes on the table.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o soir-là:a ,:o ils:o mirent:v les:o vêtements:n sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: They put the tiny shoes with the clothes.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o mirent:v les:o minuscules:a chaussures:n avec:o les:o vêtements:n .:o

sentences.en: This time, they left no leather on the table.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o fois:n ,:o ils:o ne:o laissèrent:v aucun:o cuir:n sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: Then the shoemaker and his wife hid and watched again.
sentences.tgt: Ensuite:a ,:o le:o cordonnier:n et:o sa:o femme:n se:o cachèrent:v et:o regardèrent:v de:o nouveau:a .:o

sentences.en: They waited quietly for the elves to come.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o attendirent:v tranquillement:a que:o les:o lutins:n arrivent:v .:o

sentences.en: At midnight, the two elves ran into the shop.
sentences.tgt: À:o minuit:n ,:o les:o deux:o lutins:n coururent:v dans:o la:o boutique:n .:o

sentences.en: But no leather was on the table.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o il:o n':o y:o avait:v aucun:o cuir:n sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: They saw tiny shirts, coats, and shoes.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o virent:v de:o minuscules:a chemises:n ,:o des:o manteaux:n ,:o et:o des:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: The shoemaker and his wife watched.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cordonnier:n et:o sa:o femme:n regardèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: The elves put on the shirts and the coats.
sentences.tgt: Les:o lutins:n enfilèrent:v les:o chemises:n et:o les:o manteaux:n .:o

sentences.en: They put the shoes on.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o mirent:v les:o chaussures:n .:o

sentences.en: The two elves laughed and danced around the room.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o lutins:n rirent:v et:o dansèrent:v autour:o de:o la:o pièce:n .:o

sentences.en: They danced out the door.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o dansèrent:v jusqu':o à:o la:o porte:n .:o

sentences.en: The elves ran out and never came back.
sentences.tgt: Les:o lutins:n sortirent:v en:o courant:v et:o ne:o revinrent:v jamais:o .:o

sentences.en: The shoemaker did not need help again.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cordonnier:n n':o eut:v plus:o besoin:n d':o aide:n .:o

sentences.en: He stayed rich and lived for many years.
sentences.tgt: Il:o resta:v riche:a et:o vécut:v de:o nombreuses:a années:n .:o
